changes_made.explanation: Normalized 'Spider' to 'SPIDER' (the standardized dataset name) and removed duplicate. All other metadata confirmed correct and relevant.
Normalized 'F1 score' to 'F1' (base form). All metrics are correctly extracted and used to evaluate generated SQL outputs.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. LLMs (Codex) are used for generation, not for evaluating outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. Evaluation is entirely automated using metrics like Exact Match and Attack Success Rate.

overall_notes: The paper is primarily a security study focusing on SQL injection attacks against text-to-SQL systems. The NLG evaluation is automated (metrics-based) and focuses on security vulnerabilities rather than traditional NLG quality assessment. The metadata extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed.
